newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's credit to private sector up 3.0 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Peru's credit to private sector up 3.0 pct in Sept.

text.p: Credit from Peru's banking system to the private sector stood at 26.802 billion soles at the end of September, up 3.0 percent from a month earlier, the Central Reserve Bank said Tuesday.

Local currency loans to the private sector totalled 7.157 billion soles at the end of September, up 2.1 percent from the month before, while foreign currency loans were $7.827 billion, up 1.3 percent from August.
Bank credit to the private sector stood at 20.082 billion soles at the end of 1995, compared with 13.934 billion a year earlier.
